# Search for the album 'Echo Chamber Chronicles' across all pages
query = 'Echo Chamber Chronicles'
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_results = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.search_albums(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', (len(res) if isinstance(res, list) else 'NA'))
    if not res:
        break
    all_results.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('total results', len(all_results))
# Show titles for verification
for a in all_results:
    print(a.get('album_id'), a.get('title'))

# Filter exact title match (case-insensitive)
target = [a for a in all_results if str(a.get('title','')).strip().lower() == query.strip().lower()]
print('exact matches', [(a.get('album_id'), a.get('title')) for a in target])
if not target and all_results:
    # fallback to best match by substring
    target = [a for a in all_results if query.lower() in str(a.get('title','')).lower()]
    print('substring matches', [(a.get('album_id'), a.get('title')) for a in target])
print('chosen candidates count', len(target))
print('chosen first', target[0] if target else None)

token = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password='qge1k1L')['access_token']
# Fetch play_count for each song in album 1
songs = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
info=[]
for sid in songs:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # show_song returns play_count
    info.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'play_count': s.get('play_count'),
        'artists': [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists',[])]
    })
print('song play counts')
for x in info:
    print(x['song_id'], x['title'], x['play_count'])
# Determine least listened (min play_count)
min_play = min(x['play_count'] for x in info)
least = [x for x in info if x['play_count']==min_play]
print('min_play', min_play)
print('least candidates', least)
chosen = sorted(least, key=lambda x: x['title'])[0]  # tie-break deterministic
print('chosen', chosen)
